question: Who wrote the Mauryan period book Arthashastra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishnu Gupta.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vishnu Gupta, **also known as **Chanakya or Kautilya**, wrote the **Arthashastra **during the Mauryan period.
 
• The Arthashastra is an ancient Indian text that discusses **statecraft, economic policy, and military strategy.**
 
• Kautilya is traditionally credited as the author of the text and he wrote it as a kind of handbook for kings, specifically for Chandragupta Maurya.</strong&g
